    PPC stands for pay per click. It lets your business appear in front of people who are searching for what you offer, and you pay when they click. We run these campaigns for businesses in Kenya that want more enquiries and sales, with clear ad copy and pages built to convert.

    Request a free consultation today

    Why consider paid ads for your business?

    Paid ads can put your business in front of the right people quickly. They work best when the ad matches what someone is looking for and the page they land on gives them a clear next step. We build campaigns around that simple idea.

    • Google Ads management

    We start with your goals and the customers you want to reach. From there we choose the right terms and audiences, write ads that say what you offer, and send people to pages that are easy to use. We watch the results and adjust as we go, so the budget goes toward what is working.

    Contact

    • How does a full funnel campaign work?

      Not everyone is ready to buy the first time they see an ad. We plan for people at different stages, from those just learning about your business to those comparing options or ready to enquire. Each stage gets a message that fits, so no opportunity is wasted.

    • Why do landing pages matter?

      An ad can only do so much on its own. The page people land on needs to load quickly, say clearly what you offer, and make it easy to get in touch. We build and improve those pages so the traffic you pay for has a better chance of becoming an enquiry.

    • What is remarketing?

      Most people do not enquire on their first visit. Remarketing shows your ads to those who have already been to your site, reminding them of what you offer as they browse elsewhere. It is a simple way to stay in touch with people who already know you.

    • How much does PPC cost?

      PPC has two costs to think about. One is the budget you spend with the ad platform on clicks. The other is the fee for managing the campaign. Both depend on your goals and how competitive your market is. We scope the work first and share a clear proposal before anything starts.

    • How do you manage Google Ads?

      We set up your account, group campaigns by intent, and write ads that match what people are searching for. We then monitor performance, test new angles, and adjust bids and budgets as results come in. The goal is steady improvement, not a one-off launch.

    • Why does ongoing optimisation matter?

      Ad campaigns are never truly finished. Competitors change their bids, audiences shift, and platforms update how things work. We review results regularly, remove what is not performing, and put more behind what is. That keeps your campaign useful over time rather than slowly going stale.
